newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - FTSE to drift between 4,635-4,660.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - FTSE to drift between 4,635-4,660.

text.p: The FTSE 100 index is likely to drift between 4,635-4,660 on Monday as the end of the second quarter draws to a close, technical analysts said.
Market bears tried hard to send the market lower late last week but such action was only greeted by bulls buying stock selectively but in sufficient quantity to stop a rout.

This pattern may be repeated to a lesser extent today, giving the appearance of a trendless market marking time ahead of Wednesday's budget and the market should survive any major onslaught, analysts added.
By 0723 GMT, the FTSE was indicated up 1.9 at 4,642.2.
